_why: Hashes of migrations already applied to production num-db. A sealed file must never change again: re-running an edited migration whose CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS already matched is a silent no-op, so the edit reaches fresh databases and no existing one. That is how booking_fee_minor went missing for weeks while every test passed. To change a sealed schema, add a new migration with an ALTER. scripts/apply-host-migrations.mjs seals a file after a successful remote apply.
_pending_why: Registered migrations that production has NOT had yet. Adding a migration means adding it here; applying it moves it into sealed automatically. Every registered migration must be in exactly one of the two lists, so "has production got this?" is answerable from the repo rather than from memory.
